title: One Year
description: The Mod pack used in the 2026 World allowing for automation and creation.
body:
One Year is the modpack used by Zelo45 on YT in his 2026 World Series

This modpack allows for automation of differnet materials with the Create Mod and it's addons and it allso allows for new building techniques with mods like Chipped and the Macaw's mods  




Mods included are but not limteded to:
Create
Create: copycat plus
Chipped
Farmer's delight
Macaw's bridges/doors/fences/walls/trapdoor and more 
Create: Stuff and additions
Particle Rain
And More
Thank you to the mod developers without them I wouldn't be able to have this modpack.
